description: Shot-cycle exclusions for downstream analysis. These are detected only from frontside -I_SWEEP dead-time high-current outliers, then intended to exclude both I_SWEEP and ISAT for the same run/flat_shot/cycle.
detector_polarity: inverted; -I_SWEEP must be positive during dead-time

columns.cycle_index: Langmuir sweep/dead-time cycle index; exclude the matching cycle for this flat_shot.
columns.exclude_i_sweep: 1 means exclude this run/flat_shot/cycle from I_SWEEP-based analysis.
columns.exclude_isat: 1 means exclude this run/flat_shot/cycle from ISAT-based analysis because the frontside arc can pollute both faces.
